name: GPS / GNSS / RTK
description: Structured, bounded receive and decode workflows for reviewed USB GNSS serial nodes plus installed RTK and NTRIP utilities.
help_text: GNSS Operator exposes reviewed receiver selection, duration and byte ceilings, gpsdecode modes/type filters, validated position output, and optional raw/decoded artifacts while gpsd remains off. NTRIP/RTK controls still require credential isolation, exact client lifecycle mapping, and attached-receiver tests.
